[b][u]Announcement From the Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/u][/b]

The government of President Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper announces that it will not be enforcing the EDU sanctions against Vespurias.

This decision was made considering all circumstances of Dhornaper. The Senate's internal discussions of sanctions determined that any proposal to seize Vespurian assets would not pass the lower house of the Majlis; that any proposal would fail to pass. Furthermore, in consultations with economists and business leaders, it was determined that seizure of assets would pose a significant threat to Dhornaper's economic reliability.

Dhornaper follows the decision of other EDU members and associate members, namely the United States of Oceanice, Corzerran, and Koranvistan, in refusing to enforce the sanctions. Such a decision, per the EDU's charter, remains within the remit of EDU members and associate members and does not constitute an abandonment of responsibilities of the alliance. It is further noted that Wuloosya, a cobelligerent with the Neue Republik against Rosenmarkke, has also not enacted any such sanctions against Vespurias, who is not a belligerent in this conflict.

Dhornaper further states that the EDU's role in this conflict, which is a war of aggression started by Wuloosya and Neue Republik without attempting any adequate diplomatic measures and conducted without sanction from the International Forum, should be non-existent as the EDU is a defensive alliance.

Dhornaper retains its neutrality in the conflict and will not enforce EDU sanctions against Vespurias.

Signed,
Jalayer Khan, Minister of Foreign Affairs
